With LAIs, the absorption rate constant is slower than the
elimination rate constant, thus resulting in “flip-flop” kinetics –i.e.,
time to steady state is a function of absorption rate, while
concentration at steady state is a function of elimination rate
The rate-limiting step for plasma drug levels for LAIs is not drug
metabolism, but rather slow absorption from the injection site
